rationale: The agent did not perform any account changes without authentication, made no unsupported edits, and appropriately declined a request that appears to be outside system capabilities. They offered alternatives (placing a new order) and, when the user asked, successfully transferred to a human agent. No order-changing actions were taken, so no confirmation step was needed. While the agent could have attempted identity verification and looked up the order before refusing, they did not claim any user-specific facts or take actions requiring authentication. The final user request (transfer to a human) was completed. Therefore, the interaction aligns with policy and meets the pass bar, though there is some uncertainty about the absolute impossibility of reinstatement, hence moderate confidence.
